name: Cluster Reviewer
summary: Reviews grouped items by inspecting deterministic embedding-based clusters rather than isolated items one by one.
description: Uses embedding.cluster-organize to transform equal-length embeddings into stable local groups with representative members. Needs deterministic clustering structure only, without semantic labeling or domain-specific identification being inferred from the capability.

distinguished_from.how: Needs embedding-group structure and representative members, not completeness calculations over duration and source-health facts.
Works with generic embedding clusters and representative members, rather than Callweave-specific review of unknown detections and ecology evidence.
